record.bible_text: And Benhadad<WH01130> the king<WH04428> of Syria<WH0758> gathered<WH06908><WH00> all his host<WH02428> together<WH06908><WTH8804>: and <FI>there were<Fi> thirty<WH07970> and two<WH08147> kings<WH04428> with him, and horses<WH05483>, and chariots<WH07393>: and he went up<WH05927><WTH8799> and besieged<WH06696><WTH8799> Samaria<WH08111>, and warred<WH03898><WTH8735> against it.
